stt: Ask HN: Best book you read in 2011
x: I got "The Most Human Human: What Talking with Computers Teaches Us About What It Means to Be Alive" for Christmas and it's just fascinating. Interesting history on the Turing test and AI and philosophy and very well written.  I highly recommend it.
I really enjoyed The Most Human Human by Brian Christian. It's about Turing tests and The Loebner Prize.
